metadata.description_append_html: 2026-08-03 provisional global-reader update: Adds the 4,185-page SGA 1--7 II English cumulative navigation reader, exact validation/build/input evidence, the privacy-clean project logbook, public manifest, archive caveats, and a deterministic seven-member transport ZIP. This is a provisional working checkpoint, not a terminal reference-v2 release: SGA 7 I/II source-level reference graphs, the SGA 6 R10/R6 delta, exhaustive cross-volume semantic edges, and a reproducible cumulative TeX/source package remain open.
metadata.notes_append_html: The provisional cumulative reader is direct and does not replace the standalone readers. Its privacy-clean logbook is also direct, with the exact private-to-public transformation and supersession boundary recorded in the adjacent archive README and manifest. No French scans or new license grant are included.
